context: Two friends recap a thriller movie at the cafe
purpose: Teach: 殺害/銃/爆弾/解雇/死者/探偵/悲劇/単独

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨日の映画、まだ頭から離れないんだけど、あの殺害事件のシーン、未だに鳥肌立つわ。
lines.en: I still can't get yesterday's movie out of my head — that murder scene still gives me goosebumps.
lines.style: Casual female voice, animated and slightly breathless from excitement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わかる…犯人が銃を構えた瞬間、私もう涙が止まらなくて、あれは完全に悲劇の主人公だったよね。
lines.en: I know — the moment the culprit raised the gun, I couldn't stop crying; he was a tragic hero through and through.
lines.style: Soft, emotional female voice with a wistful, romantic sigh.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最初はただの解雇された男の復讐劇かと思ったら、まさか爆弾までしかけてたとはね。
lines.en: At first I thought it was just a fired guy's revenge story, but I never expected him to plant a bomb too.
lines.style: Excited, conversational female voice with rising intonation on the twist.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あぁ、あの私立探偵が単独でビルに乗り込むとこ、かっこよすぎて心臓持ってかれた…。
lines.en: Ah, when that private detective stormed the building alone, it was so cool my heart couldn't take it.
lines.style: Dreamy female voice, trailing off with admiration.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ね、でも最後の死者数の発表のとこ、しょうがないとはいえ、もうちょっと救いが欲しかったな。
lines.en: Right, but the final death toll announcement — I get it, but I wanted a bit more hope at the end.
lines.style: Reflective female voice, softer tone, slightly disappointed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わかる、監督が次回作でちゃんと続き描いてくれるって信じたいな。
lines.en: Same — I really want to believe the director will properly continue the story in the next film.
lines.style: Hopeful female voice with a small laugh at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: とりあえずパンフ買って帰ろ、私あの探偵のセリフ全部暗記する勢いだから。
lines.en: Let's grab the pamphlet on the way out — I'm about to memorize every single one of that detective's lines.
lines.style: Bright, decisive female voice, ending on a cheerful laugh.
